annotation.evidence_span: An extension to QUIC that wishes to use a new type of frame MUST first ensure that a peer is able to understand the frame.
annotation.interpretation_a: The extension must provide a transport parameter or similar mechanism to advertise the new frame type to the peer before any such frames are sent.
annotation.interpretation_b: The extension must rely on a handshake or negotiation phase to confirm that the peer supports the new frame type before sending any such frames.
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify how the peer’s ability to understand the frame is verified, leaving the implementation behavior under‑specified.
